episodes.synopsis: Naofumi stops at Siltvelt on his journey to Q'ten Lo. The people there worship him as a king.
episodes.title: Siltvelt

episodes.synopsis: Naofumi and Raph-chan stay in the castle while the rest of the party tours the town.
episodes.title: Official Welcome

episodes.synopsis: The Schiltwelt Castle is shaken by a poisoned breakfast room disturbance. Atra, who is incensed by the ugly war of words between the various factions, tries to blackmail the heavy hitters and speak highly of Shobun's greatness. Shobun then discovers the real culprit through a “secret spy.”
episodes.title: A True People

episodes.synopsis: Fohl battles the cunning and sneaky Jaralis while Atla challenges the veteran warrior Lyceras.
episodes.title: Entrusted Power

episodes.synopsis: When Fohl is about to be defeated, Naofumi asks him if he has the resolve to become stronger.
episodes.title: White Tiger

episodes.synopsis: Naofumi returns, temporarily, to Lurolona Village, and decides who he’s going to take with him.
episodes.title: Leaving Port

episodes.synopsis: In Q’ten Lo, the party finds that it’s forbidden to kill an animal, and that the people are heavily taxed.
episodes.title: Arriving in Q'ten Lo

episodes.synopsis: The Emperor’s blessing causes the “Sealed Orochi” to revive.
episodes.title: Orochi

episodes.synopsis: A lost girl named "Zodia" appears as Muramasa suggests a drinking party.
episodes.title: Zodia

episodes.synopsis: Raphtalia goes to meet the shrine maiden of the water dragon, Shildina.
episodes.title: Prayers

episodes.synopsis: Shildina appears at the old capital and asks for a duel between representatives of both sides.
episodes.title: Oracle Miko

episodes.synopsis: The emperor challenges Raphtalia to a one-on-one duel!
episodes.title: Return of the Emperor
